These cannot be added or removed within Campaign Manager. For VPAID_LINEAR_VIDEO creatives, PARENT_VIDEO, TRANSCODED_VIDEO and ALTERNATE_VIDEO assets that are marked active serve as backup in case the VPAID creative cannot be served. Only PARENT_VIDEO assets can be added or removed for an INSTREAM_VIDEO or VPAID_LINEAR_VIDEO creative. PARENT_AUDIO refers to audios uploaded by the user in Campaign Manager and is applicable to INSTREAM_AUDIO creatives.
